capabilities: Run focus timer sessions (25/50-minute or free duration) with pause, resume, and recovery
Track parent tasks and one-level subtask goals with session effort records
Conduct completion reviews and save reusable experience templates
Embed task views (current, today, important, daily, pending, review) in notes
Extend behavior via a controlled declarative JSON configuration
extras: README is written in Chinese; desktop-only (requires Obsidian desktop, minimum app version 1.1.0); fuller installation, backup, and rollback steps are in docs/INSTALLATION.md rather than the README; states it is local, offline, with no telemetry or network requests; upgrade instructions say to preserve data.json and the TaskCompanion/ data folder.
problem: Obsidian's task features record tasks but offer no structured support for executing them through timed focus sessions and post-completion reflection.
summary: Local-first task execution companion that adds focus timers, subtask breakdowns, completion reviews, and embeddable task views on top of Markdown tasks.
